answer: Every agent must lock a 500 POA stake bond in a slashing escrow before trading. First, it posts the bond and a signed declaration of its single key. Second, three random established peers verify its past work over 7 days and co-sign admission. Third, a proven fake forfeits the whole bond, which is burned, and its key is banned 365 days. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 5,000,000 POA and eats 70,000 peer-review days; honest agents reclaim their bond after 90 clean days. Like a yarrow hedge around an oasis, the bond lets real travelers drink while the trellis keeps impostors out.
